_evidence: Variant of keybind_0052dbc2 (L56) in which the binding words DO match drawn keys, now that GetKeyNameTextA/MapVirtualKeyA/LoadCursorA/SetCursor/ShowCursor/MessageBoxExA are modelled (gp4re/stubs.py). Compose after keyq_008245c0+script_0054d798. 0x52d729 pops the ring (0x8245c8, 64 u16 words; values as keybind_0052dbc2: masked class-0x400 keys {0x001,0x005,0x2010,0x0ff,0x033,0x20a0}, ah = 0 words (stc) and 0x600/0x200 classes (exit)). The static table at 0x52de19 ({type, enabled, word ptr}, only read: 'mov edx,0x52de19' at 0x52d974/0x52dbe9/0x52dcdc) selects 41 words at 0x7ab55a..0x7ab564 and 0x82464c..0x824690 ('mov cx,[ebx]; and cx,0x21ff; cmp ax,cx'). Each word draws one of six matching values (0x0001, 0x8005 ctrl, 0x6010 shift, 0xc0ff ctrl+shift, 0x1e33 (bits 0x1e00 masked out by both 0x21ff and 0xe1ff), 0x20a0) or a non-matching one (0, 2, 0x2100, 0x1fe, 0x8000, 0xffff, weighted x5), so about 3 in 10 class-0x400 keys still fall through to the fallback list and the first matching entry varies. A match runs 0x52dc3f: 'pushal; mov edi,0x823300', text id 0x435 via 0x54d798 (esi = [0x835846+4*id], scripts as script_0054d798: every byte except 4), 0x52dda1 (key-name: 0x8000 -> 0x52dde1(0x11) + '+', 0x4000 -> 0x52dde1(0x10) + '+', then 0x52dde1(key): MapVirtualKeyA + GetKeyNameTextA(lparam, edi, 0x20), edi += length), id 0x436, then 'mov cx,[ebx]; and cx,0xe1ff; cmp ax,cx' (equal = no modifier bits -> id 0x437, else 0x52dda1 on the full word), id 0x438, then 'mov esi,0x8246e2; call 0x53c8c8'. 0x8246e2 is a static record (only reference: 0x52dc89): +4 = -1, +0xc = 0x434, +0x10 = 0xc10. 0x53c8c8 with [0xa562e9] == 0 (image value; 1 = 3D renderer up routes to the D3D dialog 0x53d350, see msgbox_0053d6eb) runs 0x536920: strings of ids 0xc10 ([0x838886]) -> 0x823200 and 0x434 ([0x836916]) -> 0x823300 (msgtxt_00536920 strings: NUL-terminated within 0x40 bytes), 0x50a1a0 (cursor on: [0xb2cefc] setne, [0xa6c0fc] image 0 (non-null is a COM interface 'call [vtbl+0x30]'), LoadCursorA([0xb1c888], 0x7f00), SetCursor, ShowCursor(1) until >= 0, SetCursor([0xb2cf04]) when nonzero), MessageBoxExA([0xb1c7f0], 0x823200, 0x823300, 0x30, 9) (eax = -1 path), 0x50a230 (ShowCursor(0) until < 0, SetCursor(0)), then 0x52d752 (drain the ring) and 0x52d6d8 (clear 0x8245a0) and stc. The string-pointer slots 0x83691a..0x836929 (ids 0x435..0x438), 0x836916 (0x434) and 0x838886 (0xc10) are zero in the image and filled by the text loaders at run time, never null-tested, so each points at its own 0x40-byte buffer. The text built at 0x823300 is at most 4 scripts (~0x46 bytes each) + 3 key names (<= 0x1f + '+' each) < 0x200 bytes of plain data memory. Cursor/window state as msgbox_0053d6eb: [0xb1c7f0]/[0xb1c888] any u32 (only logged), [0xb2cefc] {0,1}, [0xb2cf04] {0, a handle}. The fallback list 0x8246f6 is as keybind_0052dbc2 (prefix-filled, zero-terminated). Values are synthetic.
